errors.name: UserNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a user is not found during authentication or lookup by user ID.

errors.name: DocumentNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a document is not found during retrieval, modification, or deletion by document ID.

errors.name: DocumentModificationError
errors.description: Raised when a document is modified in a way that violates business rules, such as changing the user ownership or altering metadata without authorization.
